newsitem.title: UK: POLYGRAM HURT BY MUSIC SALES SLOWDOWN.
newsitem.headline: POLYGRAM HURT BY MUSIC SALES SLOWDOWN.

text.p: International music and film group PolyGram on Wednesday reported a dip in full-year earnings before taking into account a $90 million restructuring charge on its music businesses.

PolyGram's 1996 net income after tax and before extraordinary items fell to 722 million guilders ($388.8 million) from 741 million guilders in 1995. Net income per share after charges was 3.38 guilders, against a total 1995 figure of 4.12 guilders.
